test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following pairs of "sports - medal" is correct regarding performance of India in 2020 Tokyo Olympic Games?

I. Javelin Throw - Silver

II. Men's Hockey - Gold
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **India **won medals in both **Javelin Throw **and** Men's Hockey **at the **2020 Tokyo Olympic Games**.**​**
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** performed exceptionally well and won the** gold medal**, not the silver.
 
• He achieved a remarkable throw of** 87.58 meters**, securing** India's first-ever Olympic gold** **medal** in** athletics.**
 
• T**he Indian men's hockey** team had a remarkable performance in the** 2020 Tokyo Olympics**.
 
• After a thrilling and intense tournament, they reached the semifinals and eventually went on to win the** bronze medal,** not the gold.
 
• They defeated** Germany** with a score of** 5-4** in a pulsating match to secure the** bronze medal.**
 
• This achievement was significant as it marked India's** first Olympic medal **in **men's hockey** in over four decades.
